WITH customer_first AS (

  FROM ecom_v1.orders

yearly AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cf.first_order < DATE_TRUNC(o.order_date, YEAR)
             THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
             ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_rev,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS total_rev
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN customer_first cf ON o.customer_id = cf.customer_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2022, 2023, 2024)
  GROUP BY 1
)

  yr AS jahr,
  ROUND(100 * repeat_rev / total_rev, 2) AS umsatzanteil_wiederkaufer,
  ROUND(100 * repeat_rev / total_rev - LAG(100 * repeat_rev / total_rev) OVER (ORDER BY yr), 2) AS veraenderung_pp
FROM yearly
WHERE yr IN (2023, 2024)
ORDER BY yr

SELECT SUM(((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) - (oi.quantity * p.purchase_price) - ((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) * ch.commission_rate) AS deckungsbeitrag
FROM ecom_v1.orders o
JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2026-06-30'

SELECT
  ch.channel_name,
  SUM(
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
    - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
    - ch.commission_rate * ((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate))
  ) AS deckungsbeitrag
FROM ecom_v1.orders o
JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'

SELECT c.category_name,

       - SUM(oi.quantity * p.purchase_price)
       - SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) * ch.commission_rate) AS deckungsbeitrag

JOIN ecom_v1.products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

SELECT
  c.segment,
  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(ret.refund_sum), 0) AS netto_umsatz
FROM ecom_v1.customers AS c
JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_sum
  FROM ecom_v1.returns
  GROUP BY order_item_id
) AS ret
  ON ret.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.customer_id IN (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM ecom_v1.orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING MIN(order_date) < '2026-01-01'
  )
GROUP BY c.segment

WITH repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS kalendermonat,
  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(ret.refund, 0)) AS netto_umsatz
FROM ecom_v1.orders o
JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund
  FROM ecom_v1.returns
  GROUP BY order_item_id
) ret ON oi.order_item_id = ret.order_item_id
JOIN repeat_customers rc ON o.customer_id = rc.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY kalendermonat
ORDER BY kalendermonat

SELECT
  ch.channel_type,
  SUM(
    ((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
     - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0))
    * (1 - ch.commission_rate)
  ) AS umsatz
FROM ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN ecom_v1.channels AS ch
  ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.returns AS r
  ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
GROUP BY ch.channel_type
ORDER BY umsatz ASC, ch.channel_type ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT o.payment_method,
       SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount - COALESCE(ret.refund, 0)) AS umsatz
FROM ecom_v1.orders AS o
JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund
  FROM ecom_v1.returns
  GROUP BY order_item_id
) AS ret
  ON ret.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
GROUP BY o.payment_method
ORDER BY umsatz ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT cu.segment, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS umsatz
FROM ecom_v1.orders o
JOIN ecom_v1.customers cu ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id
JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
GROUP BY cu.segment
ORDER BY umsatz ASC
LIMIT 1
